认识「常闭」按钮（最容易错的地方）: Understand the "NC" Button (The Most Common Mistake)

Look at the small yellow text below the control panel: **STOP NC: 1 when not pressed**.
Both the Stop button and the overload relay `M1_OL_OK` are normally closed: **1 when not pressed, 0 when pressed**. So in the program, represent them as **NO contacts -| |-** (conducting when not pressed, open when pressed).
现场的停止按钮都接常闭：线断了也等于按了停止，电机会停，这样更安全。PLC 读到: Stop buttons in the field are wired as normally closed: if a wire breaks, it’s treated as a Stop press and the motor stops, making the system safer. The PLC reads this as 1. Using an NC contact then inverts it to 0, so the rung can never conduct, and pressing Start won’t do anything.

The Start button is normally open. When pressed, START = 1, and the normally open contact closes.
START 是常开按钮（按下才是 1），要用常开触点 -| |-，不要用常闭。选: START is a normally open button (it is 1 only when pressed), so use a normally open contact -| |-, not a normally closed contact. Select it, press Del to delete it, then add a normally open contact.

串联停止按钮 STOP（用常开触点！）: Add the STOP button in series (use a normally open contact!).
刚放的 START 是选中的（蓝色），再点「**常开**」填 `STOP`：新元: The START contact you just added is selected (blue). Click "**Normally Open**" again and enter `STOP`. The new element will be placed to the right of the selected element, in **series**.
STOP 是常闭按钮：没按时 = 1，常开触点接通，电机能转；按下停止时 = 0: STOP is a normally closed button: when it is not pressed, its value is 1 and the normally open contact closes, allowing the motor to run. When pressed, the value becomes 0, the contact opens, and the motor stops. Using a normally closed contact would reverse this behavior.
STOP 用了常闭触点：STOP 是常闭按钮，没按时已经是 1，常闭触点会把它取: STOP is using a normally closed contact. STOP is a normally closed button, so its value is already 1 when not pressed; the normally closed contact inverts it to 0. The rung is never energized, so pressing Start has no effect. Select it and right-click to change it to a normally open contact (or delete it and add it again).
串联热继电器 M1_OL_OK（也是常开触点）: Add the M1_OL_OK thermal overload relay in series (also a normally open contact).

M1_OL_OK 是电机热继电器的常闭触点：正常时 = 1，电机过载时变 0，梯: M1_OL_OK is the motor thermal overload relay's normally closed contact: its value is 1 under normal conditions and changes to 0 when the motor is overloaded, opening the rung and stopping the motor immediately.
M1_OL_OK 正常时就是 1，要用常开触点（和 STOP 一样）。: M1_OL_OK is 1 under normal conditions, so use a normally open contact (just like STOP).

线圈就是输出：左边的触点都接通时线圈得电，M1_RUN = 1，接触器吸合，电机: A coil is an output: when all the contacts on the left are closed, the coil energizes. M1_RUN = 1, the contactor pulls in, and the motor runs.

松开后电机还在转吗？（自锁）: Does the motor keep running after you release the button? (Seal-in)

如果一松手电机就停，说明并联的 M1_RUN 自锁分支没接对。: If the motor stops as soon as you release the button, the parallel M1_RUN seal-in branch is wired incorrectly.
